titles: 15 Toys We Circled in the 1960s Christmas Wish Book — Remember #1?
We Circled These 15 Toys Every Christmas in the 1960s — Remember?
15 Christmas Gifts Only Kids of the 1960s Begged For
description_intro:
These Christmas 1960s memories start with the big Wish Book landing in the mailbox, heavy as a phone book, and a pen in your hand. We lay on the living room floor and circled every toy we dreamed of finding under the tree.

From the electric train around the tree and the red screen you shook clean to Canada's Eaton's Wishing Book, the buzzing doctor game and a little oven that baked a real cake with two light bulbs, here are fifteen toys every kid wanted most.

Which one did you circle, and did you ever get it? Tell us where you grew up.
